features.name: Anonymous Session Management & Workspace Isolation
features.purpose: Provide each visitor with a fully isolated, private demo workspace without requiring account registration or credentials.
user_actions: Open the application URL in a web browser
features.behavior: When a user connects, the system inspects the signed cookie. If absent or invalid, it issues a signed UUID cookie valid for 30 days and provisions an empty session record. All subsequent profile edits, milestones, evidence, and activity are isolated to this session.
outputs: HTTP Set-Cookie header with signed UUID token (30-day max age, Lax SameSite, HttpOnly)
business_rules: Session token must be a valid 36-character UUIDv4
No cross-session data leakage
All mutation endpoints enforce same-origin verification (rejects cross-origin browser writes with 403 Forbidden)
acceptance_criteria: Visiting without a cookie establishes a valid signed cookie
Two concurrent browser sessions maintain strictly distinct profiles, roadmaps, and workforce datasets
Browser writes from external origins return HTTP 403

features.name: Profile Setup Routing Guard
features.purpose: Prevent users from accessing personalized career matching and planning features before establishing their profile.
user_actions: Attempt to visit a protected route before creating a profile
features.behavior: If the current session profile has an empty name, the app renders a dedicated Profile Setup prompt instead of the page content. Visiting /welcome, /profile, /radar, /employer, /methodology, or /settings remains allowed.
outputs: Profile Setup screen with 'Create My Profile' CTA
business_rules: Profile is considered initialized only when profile.name.trim() is non-empty
Protected routes: /, /assessment, /careers, /careers/:id, /roadmap, /progress, /scenarios, /sdgs, /updates
acceptance_criteria: Uninitialized user visiting '/' sees the 'Welcome to Skillax AI' onboarding card
Clicking 'Create My Profile' routes to '/profile'
After saving a name, all protected routes become fully accessible

features.name: Full Workspace Reset
features.purpose: Allow the user to purge all personal data, roadmaps, progress, and imported evidence in the current session.
user_actions: Confirm in the destructive alert dialog
features.behavior: The system validates the confirmation, clears the session profile, milestones, activity, recommendation history, and imported workforce evidence, resetting the session to its fresh, uninitialized state.
outputs: Cleared session state across all pages
business_rules: Clears only the active session
Confirmation dialog is mandatory with destructive styling
Restores profileCreated to false and empties profile fields
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Reset workspace' presents an alert dialog warning of data loss
Cancelling leaves all workspace data intact
Confirming resets the profile, roadmaps, and imported workforce data, and redirects/re-gates protected views

features.name: Client Preferences (Theme & Reduced Motion)
features.purpose: Enable users to configure visual dark/light themes and toggle animation motion.
features.entry_point: Header theme toggle button or /settings page switches
features.behavior: Updates localStorage key 'skillax-prefs' and toggles the CSS classes 'dark' and 'reduce-motion' on document.documentElement. Synchronizes immediately across open tabs via custom window event.
business_rules: Defaults to dark mode (true) and standard motion (false)
Persisted in browser localStorage
acceptance_criteria: Clicking header toggle switches between dark and light palettes
Toggling 'Reduce motion' suppresses entrance keyframe and CSS orbital animations
Settings persist upon browser page reload

features.name: Manual Profile Details Editing
features.purpose: Allow users to record and update their personal career demographics, professional background, and career constraints.
user_actions: Edit Name, Occupation, Industry, Education, Language
Adjust Experience, Weekly Hours, Budget inputs
Edit Professional Summary and Experience Summary textareas
features.behavior: Modifications are tracked in a local draft state. When dirty, an unsaved banner is displayed and Discard/Save buttons activate. Clicking 'Save profile' validates constraints and sends a transaction that updates the profile, recalculates all matches, and flags roadmap updates for review if a roadmap exists.
business_rules: Name is mandatory and cannot be blank
Experience cannot be negative and is capped at 60
Weekly hours must be between 1 and 80
Budget cannot be negative
Matches only recalculate upon clicking 'Save profile'
acceptance_criteria: Save button is disabled if Name is empty or draft is pristine
Typing minus sign in experience input is prevented
Discard button resets all draft inputs to the last saved profile
Saving updates career match scores and records a 'Profile saved' activity entry

features.name: 19 Catalogue Skills Rating (0 to 5)
features.purpose: Allow users to self-rate proficiency across 19 standard skills categorized as Transferable, Digital, or Technical.
user_actions: Drag or click sliders from 0 to 5 for any of the 19 catalogue skills
features.behavior: Updating a slider updates the draft skill list. If rating is 0, the skill is removed from the active list. If rating > 0, the skill level is updated. Changed skills are highlighted in primary accent.
outputs: Proficiency counter in category header (e.g. '3 of 5 rated')
business_rules: Catalogue skills: communication, excel, organization, analysis, python, sql, ai, ml, ethics, automation, maintenance, iot, cloud, sustainability, design, security, teaching, health, agriculture
Proficiency scale: 0 (none) to 5 (expert)
Duplicate skills are rejected on submission
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 19 skills displays a slider with discrete steps 0 to 5
Setting a slider to 0 removes it from the saved profile skills array
Rated skills display level/5 badge and highlight changes against previously saved state

features.name: Career Interests Tag Management
features.purpose: Allow users to specify industry and sectoral interests that feed into the interest alignment scoring component.
user_actions: Type interest tag in input and press Enter
Click 'X' icon on interest badge to remove tag
features.behavior: New tag is trimmed and appended if non-duplicate. Removing removes the tag from the draft list. Interest tags provide 100% interestScore match when matching role industry or title.
business_rules: No duplicate interest tags allowed
Blank tags ignored
acceptance_criteria: Submitting a new interest tag adds a badge
Clicking the remove icon immediately removes the badge
Adding an interest matching a role industry boosts that role's interestScore to 100

features.name: Additional Non-Catalogue Skills Management
features.purpose: Store custom or specialized user skills that fall outside the 19 standard matching catalogue skills.
features.entry_point: /profile -> Additional skills panel (visible when additionalSkills exist)
user_actions: Remove custom skill by clicking 'X' icon
features.behavior: Additional skills are preserved as part of the profile JSON. They do not invent artificial requirements or affect deterministic career match scores.
outputs: List of additional skills with inputs and remove controls
business_rules: Max 60 additional skills
Name max 100 chars
Level must be 0-5
Does not contribute to career match scoring
acceptance_criteria: Panel only appears when profile contains additionalSkills
User can edit name and level or delete individual entries
Career match scores remain strictly determined by catalogue skills only

features.name: Consented Gemini PDF CV Analysis
features.purpose: Extract structured career information and skill suggestions from a fictional PDF CV using Google Gemini AI.
user_actions: Select PDF file (up to 10 MB, up to 30 pages)
Check external AI processing consent checkbox
features.behavior: The browser uploads the PDF with consent flags. The server enforces rate limiting (6 req/15min) and concurrency limits (max 2), verifies PDF magic headers and page counts, and invokes Gemini with a strict system instruction. Returned structured output is parsed, validated against strict schemas, and presented for user review. No raw CV or full prompt output is stored.
outputs: Structured CV analysis result: currentRole, education, experienceYears, technicalSkills, softSkills, experience, certifications, projects, careerInterests, analysisNotes
business_rules: PDF only, max 10 MB, 1-30 pages
Both consent and synthetic declaration checkboxes must be checked
Skills with empty evidence are forced to 'Unknown' proficiency
Unknown proficiency is unrated (level 0) and never produces positive score contribution
Server buffer is zeroed out immediately after processing
acceptance_criteria: 'Analyze CV' is disabled until file, consent, and synthetic boxes are checked
Uploading non-PDF or file >10 MB triggers client/server error
Successful extraction displays the review panel with model attribution badge
Evidence quotes are displayed for every extracted skill

features.name: Offline Synthetic Demo CV Extraction
features.purpose: Provide a deterministic, offline sample extraction demonstration without making external AI API calls.
features.entry_point: /profile -> CV analysis panel -> Fictional sample CV section
user_actions: Select sample from dropdown ('Computer Science Graduate', 'Administrative Assistant', 'Manufacturing Technician')
features.behavior: Sends request to /api/cv/demo with selected sampleId. The server returns a pre-configured synthetic analysis result clearly labelled as 'Synthetic demo response · No Gemini call'.
outputs: Structured review panel with sample profile data
business_rules: Never calls Gemini API
Must clearly disclose synthetic origin
Allows testing review workflow when Gemini is unconfigured or offline
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Try a Sample CV' immediately populates the review panel
Attribution reads 'Synthetic demo response · No Gemini call'
No network calls to Google are made

features.name: Fictional Sample CV PDF Download
features.purpose: Allow users to download real, pre-generated fictional PDF CV documents to test live file uploads.
features.entry_point: /profile -> CV analysis panel -> 'Download sample PDF' link
user_actions: Click 'Download sample PDF' link next to sample selector
features.behavior: Downloads an authentic PDF document generated in-memory with standard fonts (e.g. 'skillax-fictional-graduate.pdf') corresponding to the selected sample.
business_rules: Generates clean, compliant PDF bytes with %PDF- header and %%EOF trailer
Clearly marked as fictional in document title
acceptance_criteria: Clicking link downloads a valid PDF matching selected sample role
Downloaded PDF can be immediately re-uploaded into F-009 for live analysis

features.name: CV Extraction Review & Merge to Draft
features.purpose: Require human verification and editing of AI-suggested CV fields before applying them to the profile draft.
features.entry_point: /profile -> CV review panel (after analysis or demo)
user_actions: Edit extracted occupation, education, experience years, interests
Edit professional summary and experience textareas
Click 'Apply reviewed information to draft' or 'Dismiss'
features.behavior: User edits the proposed fields. Clicking 'Apply reviewed information to draft' merges approved values into the active draft profile: catalogue skills map to matching catalogue IDs, non-catalogue skills are added to additionalSkills, and other fields update the draft. Nothing is written to the database until the user explicitly clicks 'Save profile'.
outputs: Notification toast instructing user to save profile
business_rules: Unknown proficiency maps to 0 and does not invent positive score contribution
Applying to draft is NOT a database write
Dismissing discards suggestions without saving
acceptance_criteria: Unchecking a skill excludes it from draft
Applying to draft updates profile form fields and marks draft as dirty
Database is not modified until user clicks 'Save profile'

features.name: Deterministic Keyword Text Intake
features.purpose: Provide a simple fallback text extraction method using local keyword pattern matching without language models.
features.entry_point: /profile -> Expandable section 'Optional keyword text intake (no Gemini)'
user_actions: Upload text/PDF file or paste synthetic CV text
Click 'Use sample' to populate example text
features.behavior: Extracts skills by searching text against documented alias keywords for 19 catalogue skills. Detected skills are suggested at Level 1. Raw text is never persisted. Clicking 'Apply to draft' merges selected suggestions into the draft profile.
business_rules: Suggested skills default to unverified level 1
Raw text is discarded immediately after extraction
No LLM is active in this feature
acceptance_criteria: Pasting text containing 'Python and Excel' suggests python and excel at Level 1
Explanation discloses deterministic keyword rules
Applying merges skills to draft with toast confirmation

features.name: Career Assessment Wizard
features.purpose: Guide users through a structured multi-step survey to rate skills and constraints in conversational language.
user_actions: Step 3+: Rate skills using descriptive 6-point scale ('Never done it' to 'I teach it')
Navigate with Back / Next buttons or step indicators
Click 'Update my profile' on final step
features.behavior: Tracks answers across multiple category steps. On submit, validates values, executes 'saveProfile' action, recalculates matches, and automatically navigates to /careers.
business_rules: Total steps = 2 + number of skill categories (5 steps total)
Descriptive scale: 0='Never done it', 1='Seen it done', 2='Done with help', 3='Do it on my own', 4='Others ask me', 5='I teach it'
Submitting commits profile directly to server
acceptance_criteria: Step progress bar visually indicates current step
Selecting descriptive options updates numeric skill level
Submitting updates profile and redirects user to /careers

features.name: Personal Intelligence Briefing & Top Match Card
features.purpose: Provide an executive summary of the user's skill profile and highlight their highest-scoring career match.
features.behavior: Displays user's first name, occupation, industry, years experience, mapped skill count, and a prominent score ring for the #1 ranked role with gap count, carry-over skills, and estimated learning hours. Clicking routes to career detail.
business_rules: If profile is uninitialized, user is gated by F-002
Top role is the first item in ranked matches array
acceptance_criteria: Displays correct profile name and highest match score
Top match card displays score ring, role title, industry, estimated hours, and gaps
Clicking card navigates to /careers/:topRoleId

features.name: Skill Shape vs. Target Pathway Radar Visualization
features.purpose: Visually compare the user's category-level capabilities against the requirements of their top match.
features.entry_point: Dashboard root page ('/') -> 'Skill shape vs strongest pathway' panel
user_actions: Hover over radar chart vertices to view tooltip breakdown
features.behavior: Computes average proficiency (0-5) across skill categories (Transferable, Digital, Technical) for the user (cyan area) and top role requirements (dashed violet outline). Tooltip displays category scores.
business_rules: Category average = sum of levels in category / count of skills in category
Target requirements average = sum of requirement levels in category / count
acceptance_criteria: Radar chart displays polygon for user skills and dashed line for target role
Axes correspond to skill categories
Hovering vertices shows exact numeric values

features.name: Ranked Roles Score Decomposition Stacked Chart
features.purpose: Demonstrate the mathematical composition of match scores across the top 6 careers.
features.entry_point: Dashboard root page ('/') -> 'Why these roles rank' panel
features.behavior: Displays horizontal stacked bars for top 6 roles. Each bar is divided into weighted point contributions: Direct skills, Transferable, Interest fit, Research activity, and Workforce indicator (if present). Tooltip reveals exact points.
business_rules: Components scaled by (1 - workforceWeight) when workforceScore is present
X-axis fixed at 0 to 100 points
acceptance_criteria: Shows top 6 roles on Y-axis and 0-100 score on X-axis
Bars accurately represent sum of weighted points
Clicking 'All matches' navigates to /careers

features.name: Next Move Active Milestone Card
features.purpose: Provide immediate visibility and progress for the user's next uncompleted roadmap milestone.
user_actions: Click 'Choose a target' button (if no roadmap)
features.behavior: If a roadmap exists, finds the first uncompleted milestone by phase and displays its title, objective, hours, provider, and progress bar. If all complete, congratulates user. If no roadmap, shows empty state with CTA.
business_rules: Finds lowest phase uncompleted milestone
Progress bar = (completed count / total count) * 100
acceptance_criteria: Displays next pending milestone title, provider, and hours
Shows overall roadmap progress percentage bar
Clicking 'Open roadmap' navigates to /roadmap

features.name: Fresh Research Evidence Digest
features.purpose: Display the latest public research observations affecting the skill ecosystem.
user_actions: Click 'Radar' link to view all signals
features.behavior: Lists the 4 most recently published research signals with directional trend icon, title, source name, and publication date.
business_rules: Sorted descending by publishedAt
Signals represent technical research activity, not job vacancies
acceptance_criteria: Renders top 4 research signals sorted by date
Shows source name and formatted publication date
Clicking 'Radar' navigates to /radar

features.name: SDG Impact Footprint Card
features.purpose: Highlight the UN Sustainable Development Goals most closely aligned with the user's skills and top pathways.
features.behavior: Calculates link frequency across user's active skills (weight 1) and top 3 career matches (weight 2). Displays the top 6 linked SDGs with official color badges and link counts.
outputs: List of top 6 linked SDGs with badges and counts
business_rules: Top 3 roles contribute 2 links per SDG; user skills contribute 1 link per SDG
Displays up to 6 highest frequency goals
acceptance_criteria: Calculates and ranks top 6 linked SDGs
Each item renders official SDG number badge and name
Clicking 'All 17' navigates to /sdgs

features.name: Workspace Activity Audit Log
features.purpose: Provide a chronological audit trail of all major actions taken in the current session.
features.behavior: Displays a vertical timeline showing the last 6 actions recorded in the session (e.g. profile saved, roadmap generated, milestone completed, research refreshed) with formatted timestamps.
outputs: Timeline list of up to 6 events with title and timestamp
business_rules: Activity array capped at 30 items on server
Chronological descending order
acceptance_criteria: Displays newest action at top with dot marker and date
Actions reflect actual user operations performed in session

features.name: Replanning Banner & Header Alert Chip
features.purpose: Alert the user whenever underlying data or scenario changes cause a proposed update to their learning roadmap.
user_actions: Click 'Plan update awaiting review' header chip or dashboard banner
features.behavior: When ws.replanningPending is true, displays a pulsing banner on the dashboard and an alert chip in the header linking directly to /updates. Sidebar navigation item 'Replanning' also displays a 'REVIEW' badge.
outputs: Visible banner, chip, and badge linking to /updates
business_rules: replanningPending is true when rank order shifts, a score changes by >=1 point, or milestone priorities change, AND a roadmap is present
acceptance_criteria: Alert chip and dashboard banner appear when replanningPending is true
Clicking either banner or chip navigates to /updates
Disappears once the update is approved or rejected

features.name: Public Research Feeds Retrieval & Refresh
features.purpose: Fetch and ingest real-world engineering and research RSS feeds (Hugging Face and MIT AI News) to update technical activity signals.
features.behavior: Triggers backend fetch of RSS feeds. Server parses items, extracts skill keywords, caches items in database, and returns fresh signals. A rate limiter restricts requests to once per minute. If network fails, cached observations remain available with an error banner.
business_rules: Sources: Hugging Face Research & MIT AI News
Rate limited to 1 call per 60 seconds
Observations tagged with mode='live' or mode='cached'
Keyword matches are research activity proxies, NOT job vacancies
acceptance_criteria: Clicking button initiates fetch with spinner feedback
Refreshed timestamp updates to current time
Rapid consecutive clicks show rate-limit message and retain latest data

features.name: Research Activity Signals Filtering & Search
features.purpose: Allow users to filter and search public research signals by direction, retrieval mode, skill, and text.
user_actions: Type search keyword in search box
features.behavior: Filters the signals array in real time across title, source, observation, direction, mode, and tagged skill IDs. If no match, displays EmptyState.
business_rules: Case-insensitive search across title, source, and observation text
Multi-condition AND filtering
acceptance_criteria: Typing a search term filters signal cards immediately
Selecting a skill shows only signals tagged with that skill
Empty match displays 'No signals match' with prompt to loosen filters

features.name: Research Provenance & Transparency Display
features.purpose: Provide complete auditability and attribution for every public research signal.
user_actions: Click external link icon to open original research article
features.behavior: Each signal card displays its title, observation text, tagged skill badges, publisher name, publication date, retrieval date, retrieval mode tag, and an HTTPS external link opening the original source article in a new tab.
outputs: Attributed card with external source link
business_rules: External links must open in new tab with rel='noreferrer'
Retrieval mode (live/cached/synthetic) must be explicitly disclosed
acceptance_criteria: Card shows source, published date, retrieved date, and mode
Clicking external link opens original publication URL

features.name: Evidence Article Count per Skill Visualization
features.purpose: Show the volume of research literature tagged to each skill across the evidence pool.
features.entry_point: /radar -> Research Activity tab -> Bar chart panel
user_actions: Hover over bars to view article count
features.behavior: Aggregates signal occurrences per skill and displays the top 10 skills in a vertical bar chart. Subtitle explicitly notes that article counts indicate research volume, not labour demand.
outputs: Bar chart of top 10 tagged skills
business_rules: Sorted descending by article count
Displays top 10 skills
acceptance_criteria: Top 10 skills rendered with correct article frequencies
Disclaimer clearly states 'Counts of articles, not demand'

features.name: Workforce Demand Trend Analytics & Filtering
features.purpose: Explore time-series workforce indicators and trends derived from imported workforce datasets.
features.behavior: Filters imported workforce trends. When a series is selected, displays its trend badge (Rising/Declining/Stable/Insufficient Data), source provenance, and details. If no workforce data exists, displays EmptyState prompting user to 'Manage Data'.
outputs: Interactive trend panel with metrics and metadata
business_rules: Filter dropdowns hidden if only one option exists
Never averages across independent series or geographies
acceptance_criteria: Empty state directs user to 'Manage Data' when no datasets are imported
Filtering by skill updates available series
Shows source name, geography, unit, and methodology limitations

features.name: Workforce Trend Chronological Line Chart & Comparability Engine
features.purpose: Enforce rigorous statistical comparability rules before rendering historical workforce trends.
user_actions: View line chart of observation values over time
Expand 'Sources, measurement periods and limitations' details
features.behavior: Evaluates whether observations within a series are comparable (same source, definition, method, unit, frequency class, and non-overlapping periods). If comparable, renders a line chart and displays absolute and relative percentage change. If non-comparable, suppresses the chart and displays an explanatory comparability limitation message.
outputs: Line chart OR comparability explanation box
business_rules: Requires >= 2 non-overlapping observations of matching periodClass
Relative change > +5% is 'Rising', < -5% is 'Declining', else 'Stable'
If previous value is 0, percentage change is null and label is 'Insufficient Data'
acceptance_criteria: Compatible periods render smooth line chart with data points
Incompatible periods render warning box with exact failure reason
Displays absolute change and percentage change between last two compatible periods

features.name: Synthetic Workforce Baseline & Update Loading
features.purpose: Allow one-click loading of pre-packaged synthetic workforce datasets to demonstrate scoring and replanning flows.
features.behavior: Fetches pre-packaged demonstration JSON from public assets, loads it into the dataset textarea, sets format to JSON, and prepares it for validation. Baseline loads Q1/Q2 stable records; Update loads Q3 shifted records.
outputs: Populated textarea with formatted JSON dataset
business_rules: Synthetic datasets must have synthetic: true and evidenceType: 'synthetic'
Baseline should be validated and confirmed before update
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Load synthetic baseline' fills textarea with valid baseline JSON
Clicking 'Load synthetic update' fills textarea with valid Q3 update JSON

features.name: Custom Workforce Dataset Ingestion & Validation
features.purpose: Validate and atomically ingest user-supplied CSV or JSON workforce datasets into the active session.
user_actions: Upload file or paste dataset content
features.behavior: Validation mode parses and validates rows against strict schema constraints (dates, units, supported skills, HTTPS URLs, value bounds) without saving anything. It generates a SHA-256 checksum and returns a 20-row preview. Confirm mode checks that checksum matches preview; on match, atomically inserts observations into session, updates session workforce trends, recalculates matches, and triggers replanning snapshot if scores change.
business_rules: File size <= 1 MB
1 to 500 records per import
Max 5000 records per session
Duplicate observation keys or IDs strictly rejected
Non-synthetic records require HTTPS sourceUrl, definition, and method
Supported units: count, job_postings, percent, percentage, index, synthetic_index
acceptance_criteria: Preview mode does not store any rows in the database
Confirming with mismatched checksum is rejected with HTTP 400
Duplicate records trigger immediate rejection and roll back transaction
Successfully imported rows immediately update workforce indicator scores

features.name: Session Workforce Evidence Reset
features.purpose: Clear all imported workforce observations in the current session while preserving the user profile, roadmap, and milestone progress.
features.entry_point: /radar -> 'Manage Data' modal -> 'Reset workforce demo data' button
user_actions: Confirm in the destructive alert dialog
features.behavior: Deletes all workforce import records belonging to the active session. Recalculates career matches back to the 4-component baseline, logs a recalculation snapshot, and retains the user profile, milestones, and progress.
business_rules: Deletes only workforceImports for the active session
Preserves user profile, milestones, completion, and history
acceptance_criteria: Clearing workforce imports resets workforce trends to empty
Career matches revert to 4-component scoring
Profile fields and completed roadmap milestones remain completely intact

features.name: Deterministic Career Matching & Ranking Engine
features.purpose: Compute suitability scores and skill gaps for all catalogued occupations using transparent, explainable formulas.
user_actions: None (automatic deterministic calculation upon profile, scenario, or evidence change)
features.behavior: Evaluates the 10 catalogued roles. Computes skillsScore (50%), transferableScore (20%), interestScore (15%), and marketScore (15%). If a compatible workforce indicator exists, integrates workforceScore (10%) and scales baseline (90%). Ranks roles descending by score.
outputs: Ranked Match array with component scores, missing skills, relevant skills, hours, and explanations
business_rules: Deterministic: identical inputs guarantee identical rankings
Direct skills alignment averages min(current/required, 1)
Hours = sum(ceil(resource_hours * (1 - current/required))) + 16
Tie-breaker sorts alphabetically by roleId
acceptance_criteria: Score strictly satisfies formula bounds (0 to 100)
Missing skills accurately lists requirements where current < required
Estimated hours accurately reflects skill gaps plus 16 base project hours

features.name: Career Matches Directory & Search
features.purpose: Browse, filter, and inspect all ranked career opportunities.
user_actions: Type role name in search input
features.behavior: Displays ranked career cards with rank number, score ring, role name, industry, missing gap count, learning hours, SDG badges, and component bars. Card is highlighted if it is the current target. Clicking navigates to /careers/:id.
business_rules: Filters apply concurrently
Target role card receives 'TARGET' badge and glow styling
acceptance_criteria: Searching 'analyst' displays Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Analyst, Sustainability Analyst, Information Security Analyst
Industry dropdown isolates roles in selected sector
Clicking card navigates to /careers/:id

features.name: Score Decomposition & Mathematical Audit View
features.purpose: Allow users to deconstruct and audit every point contributing to a career match score.
user_actions: Hover over horizontal bar chart components
features.behavior: Renders a score ring, sum equation (e.g. '28.3 + 16.0 + 15.0 + 9.8'), a horizontal bar chart showing raw score vs. weighted points for each component, and an audit paragraph stating the exact formula, signals, and occupational sources.
business_rules: Sum of weighted points equals final match score within 0.1 rounding
Displays explicit workforce indicator and research proxies disclosures
acceptance_criteria: Decomposition bars accurately reflect raw and weighted component points
Explanation paragraph details exact calculation and source attribution

features.name: Proficiency Gap Analysis & Level Comparison
features.purpose: Compare user's current proficiency against required levels for every skill in a role.
user_actions: Inspect comparative bar chart (Current vs. Required)
Review gap list with level dots and shortfall indicators
features.behavior: Displays a dual-bar chart showing Current level (cyan) vs. Required level (violet) from 0 to 5 for every required skill. Below the chart, lists each skill with LevelDots visualizer and shortfall badge ('met' or '-X').
business_rules: Shortfall = Required level - Current level (if current < required)
Status is 'met' if current >= required
acceptance_criteria: Dual-bar chart displays current vs required levels (0-5) for each requirement
LevelDots accurately represents current rating and required ring
Negative shortfall numbers match required minus current level

features.name: Target Role Designation
features.purpose: Set a specific career as the primary target for learning roadmap generation and tracking.
features.behavior: Sends action 'selectRole' with role ID. The server updates selectedRoleId. The button changes to 'Current target' (disabled), and the role receives the TARGET badge across the application.
business_rules: Button disabled if role is already the current target
Target role selection persists in session
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Set as target' marks the role as selectedRoleId
Button label changes to 'Current target' and is disabled
Role card on /careers displays TARGET badge

features.name: Role SDG Impact & Rationale
features.purpose: Explain how a specific career path contributes to global sustainable development targets.
user_actions: Inspect transferable strengths and missing skills pills
features.behavior: Renders official SDG badges linked to the role, displays the specific SDG contribution rationale paragraph, and shows pills for transferable strengths carried over versus missing skills to acquire.
business_rules: Discloses that connections are documented contribution pathways, not verified impact or UN endorsements
acceptance_criteria: Displays correct SDG badges matching role's SDG IDs
Displays full SDG rationale text and transferable/missing skill pills

features.name: O*NET Occupational Reference Linkage
features.purpose: Provide verifiable external reference standards for career definitions.
features.behavior: Opens the corresponding O*NET OnLine summary report page in a new browser tab (e.g. https://www.onetonline.org/link/summary/15-2051.01).
outputs: New browser tab with O*NET occupational data
business_rules: Must open in new tab with target='_blank' and rel='noreferrer'
Discloses that curated proficiencies are SKILLAX modelling choices, not official O*NET measurements
acceptance_criteria: Clicking link opens valid O*NET summary URL in new tab

features.name: AI Adoption Scenario Switching
features.purpose: Compare occupational stability and requirements under Slower, Moderate, and Rapid AI adoption pathways.
user_actions: Click 'Apply' button on Slower, Moderate, or Rapid adoption card
features.behavior: Sends action 'setScenario'. Updates active scenario in session, alters role requirements (Rapid increases AI literacy level by 1 or adds Level 3; Slower decreases by 1, min 1), recalculates career matches, and triggers replanning proposal if roadmap exists.
business_rules: Slower: AI literacy requirement reduced by 1 (min 1); market effect = -10 * techShare + 0.05 * exposure
Moderate: standard requirements; market effect = 0
Rapid: AI literacy requirement increased by 1 (max 5) or added at level 3; market effect = 20 * techShare - 0.1 * exposure
Scenarios are modelling assumptions, not measured forecasts
acceptance_criteria: Clicking 'Apply' switches active scenario across app and header tag
Rapid scenario increases AI requirements on roles and modifies scores
Slower scenario decreases AI requirements and adjusts scores

features.name: Cross-Scenario Score Comparison Chart
features.purpose: Compare career match scores across all three adoption pathways side-by-side.
user_actions: Hover over chart bars to view score comparison across Slower, Moderate, and Rapid
features.behavior: Renders a grouped bar chart for the top 8 roles displaying three bars per role: Slower (green), Moderate (cyan), and Rapid (violet). Tooltip shows exact scores.
outputs: Grouped bar chart for top 8 roles
business_rules: Sorted descending by Rapid match score
Shows top 8 roles
acceptance_criteria: Renders 3 distinct colored bars per role for Slower, Moderate, and Rapid
Hovering bar shows tooltip with scores for all three scenarios

features.name: Hypothetical Simulation Boost Slider
features.purpose: Test sensitivity of career rankings to hypothetical shifts in technical market demand.
user_actions: Drag slider from -100 to +100 in steps of 5
Click 'Clear' button to reset boost to 0
features.behavior: On slider release, sends action 'simulate' with the numeric value. Adjusts the market component of roles proportional to their technical skill share. An active simulation badge is displayed whenever boost != 0.
business_rules: Market adjustment = boost * technicalShare * 0.4
Technical skills: ai, ml, automation, iot, cloud, security, python
Labelled what-if only; explicitly disclosed as non-empirical
states: Simulation active (boost != 0, Clear active, warning label shown)
acceptance_criteria: Moving slider modifies role scores in real time upon commit
Active simulation displays warning: 'SIMULATION ACTIVE (+X)'
Clicking 'Clear' resets slider to 0 and restores empirical scores

features.name: Gap-Based 4-Phase Learning Pathway Generation
features.purpose: Generate an ordered sequence of learning milestones to close skill gaps for a selected target role.
features.behavior: Analyzes skill gaps between user profile and target role requirements. Generates Phase 1 (foundational) and Phase 2 (applied) milestones for skill gaps, followed by Phase 3 (portfolio project, 10h) and Phase 4 (transition plan, 6h). Preserves completion status of previously completed milestones. Clears any pending replanning flags.
business_rules: Phase 1 if current level < 2; Phase 2 if current level >= 2
Phases 3 and 4 are fixed capstone milestones
Urgency prioritizes AI/ML/automation in Rapid and deprioritizes in Slower
Workforce indicators prioritize high-demand gaps
Completed milestones from previous plan are preserved
acceptance_criteria: Generates ordered milestones grouped by Phase 1 through Phase 4
Each milestone links to free public learning hub (OpenLearn, Microsoft Learn, freeCodeCamp, Google)
Regenerating preserves completion checkmarks of already completed milestones

features.name: Milestone Self-Reported Completion Tracking
features.purpose: Allow users to toggle completion status on individual roadmap milestones and track progress.
user_actions: Click milestone checkmark circle to mark complete or incomplete
features.behavior: Sends action 'completeMilestone' with milestone ID and toggled completed boolean. Updates milestone status, recalculates overall progress percentage, logs an activity entry, and persists state in session.
outputs: Updated milestone appearance (line-through title, filled badge)
business_rules: Completion is self-reported
Persisted in session JSON and survives page reloads
acceptance_criteria: Clicking circle marks milestone complete with checkmark and strike-through title
Clicking again reopens milestone
Progress bar on /roadmap and /progress updates immediately

features.name: Roadmap Export (JSON & Print/Save as PDF)
features.purpose: Allow users to export their personalized learning roadmap as structured portable JSON or print-ready PDF.
user_actions: In modal, click 'Print / Save as PDF'
features.behavior: Fetches validated export payload from /api/skillax/roadmap/export. 'Download JSON' triggers browser file download of 'skillax-learning-roadmap.json'. 'Print / Save as PDF' invokes window.print() targeting a portal element formatted specifically with CSS print styles.
outputs: Browser print dialog formatted for A4 page
business_rules: Disabled if no roadmap is generated
Print CSS hides background UI and formats clean black/white document with milestones, URLs, and disclaimers
acceptance_criteria: 'Export Plan' button disabled when roadmap is empty
Clicking 'Download JSON' saves formatted JSON file containing milestones, skills, and SDGs
Clicking 'Print / Save as PDF' opens system print dialog with clean document formatting

features.name: Learning Progress & Phase Effort Analytics
features.purpose: Provide comprehensive tracking of completed versus remaining hours and pace toward career readiness.
user_actions: Review stats (Milestones, Hours logged, Remaining, At your pace)
Inspect 'Hours by phase' stacked bar chart
features.behavior: Calculates completed hours vs. estimated remaining hours. Compares remaining hours against user's weekly learning availability to compute estimated weeks to completion. Renders stacked bar chart of completed vs. remaining hours per phase.
business_rules: Pace weeks = ceil((hoursTotal - hoursDone) / max(1, weeklyHours))
Progress percentage = round((doneCount / totalCount) * 100)
acceptance_criteria: Displays accurate completion percentage in central score ring
Stacked bar chart breaks down completed vs remaining hours per phase
Estimated weeks updates accurately based on profile weekly hours

features.name: Human-in-the-Loop Replanning Review
features.purpose: Allow users to inspect proposed ranking changes and explicitly approve or reject updates to their saved learning plan.
user_actions: Inspect ranking comparison table (Rank, Role, Previous, Now, Delta)
features.behavior: When evidence shifts, the system stores a recalculation snapshot. /updates compares previous matches to current matches with green/red rank and score deltas. Clicking 'Approve update' regenerates the roadmap incorporating the new priorities while preserving all completed work. Clicking 'Keep current plan' rejects the proposal and keeps the current roadmap untouched. Clears replanningPending flag.
outputs: Updated roadmap (on approve) OR retained roadmap (on reject)
business_rules: Roadmap NEVER changes automatically without user approval
Approving regenerates against current completion state; completed milestones are preserved
Rejecting marks snapshot status as 'Rejected' and retains existing plan
acceptance_criteria: Comparison table displays previous vs current rank and score with delta arrows
Clicking 'Approve update' updates roadmap milestones and clears review alert
Clicking 'Keep current plan' retains existing roadmap and clears review alert
Completed milestones are never erased during replanning

features.name: Recommendation History Audit Trail
features.purpose: Maintain an immutable, chronological audit trail of all recommendation recalculations and user review decisions.
features.behavior: Lists chronological snapshots (newest first) recording timestamp, reason, scenario, review status (Pending Review, Approved, Rejected, No Change), explanation, affected skills, dataset versions, role rank changes, evidence references, and proposed skill orders. Paginated via offset query.
outputs: Chronological list of recalculation snapshots with expandable details
business_rules: History is append-only
Records exact before/after score arrays and evidence IDs
New evidence supersedes unreviewed pending proposals, marking them 'Rejected' with explicit reason
acceptance_criteria: Shows count of recorded recalculations in summary header
Expanding item details shows before/after rank shifts and evidence citations
Clicking 'Load older changes' fetches next 50 items

features.name: 17 UN Sustainable Development Goals Directory
features.purpose: Provide an interactive exploration of all 17 UN SDGs and their connections to skills and occupations.
user_actions: Click any of the 17 SDG grid buttons
Inspect SDG description and UN reference link
features.behavior: Displays a grid of all 17 official UN SDGs with official colors, numbers, names, and link counts. Clicking a goal displays its description, external UN reference link, catalogued roles contributing to the goal, and skills contributing to the goal (with user-acquired skills highlighted).
business_rules: All 17 goals mapped in catalogue
Swatch text color dynamically calculated for contrast
Highlighted skills reflect skills where user level > 0
acceptance_criteria: Grid displays all 17 goals with correct official colors and high-contrast text
Selecting a goal updates role list and skill badges
Skills held by user are highlighted with proficiency level

features.name: Employer Workforce Cohort Analytics
features.purpose: Provide aggregated capability analysis and training shortfall analytics across a synthetic workforce cohort.
user_actions: Review cohort stats (Cohort size, Avg experience, Avg learning time, Roles assessed)
Inspect 'Capability by category' grouped bar chart
Inspect 'Most common training needs' shortfall ranking
features.behavior: Aggregates the 3 synthetic demo profiles (Aina, Daniel, Kumar). Renders capability averages per category per worker, ranks the most common skill shortfalls across the cohort against all catalogued roles, and displays summary statistics. Prominently disclaims that data is for training planning, never candidate screening.
business_rules: Explicitly synthetic cohort only
Strictly prohibited from screening or ranking individuals for employment
acceptance_criteria: Displays 3 synthetic workers in grouped capability bar chart
Training needs ranking displays skills with greatest shortfalls across cohort
Header explicitly disclaims screening/selection use

features.name: Workforce Requirement Coverage Matrix
features.purpose: Provide a matrix overview of requirement coverage percentage for each worker across every catalogued occupation.
user_actions: Scroll table horizontally/vertically to inspect coverage percentages
features.behavior: Renders a matrix table with roles as rows and workers as columns. Each cell calculates: sum(min(1, worker_level / required_level)) / requirements_length * 100. Cells are styled with dynamic background opacity based on coverage percentage.
business_rules: Coverage = average of min(1, current / required) across requirements * 100
Simpler in-browser index than the full matching formula
acceptance_criteria: Table displays all 10 roles against 3 synthetic workers
Percentages accurately reflect requirement coverage
Background color intensity scales with percentage

features.name: Methodology & Algorithmic Transparency Documentation
features.purpose: Provide complete public disclosure of all mathematical formulas, scenario parameters, assumptions, and algorithmic limitations.
user_actions: Read match formula code block and component definitions
Expand 'Workforce evidence, history and scenario methodology'
features.behavior: Documents the exact mathematical formulas for direct skills, transferable skills, interest alignment, research market index, and workforce indicator. Details scenario adjustment constants, simulation formulas, O*NET mappings, and limitations.
business_rules: Complete open transparency without proprietary black-boxes
acceptance_criteria: Displays complete formula: 0.50*skills + 0.20*transferable + 0.15*interest + 0.15*market
Documents workforce indicator weighting (10%) and comparability rules
Details Rapid and Slower scenario mathematical adjustments

outputs: Lists of external sources and providers with hyperlinks

No paid certification or HRD Corp eligibility claimed

Lists all 10 O*NET links opening in new tabs
